changelog:
Initial release of docx-toolkit — a comprehensive tool for extracting content from Word documents.

- Extracts text, tables (with structure), and images from both .docx and legacy .doc files
- Supports large documents and complex/CJK (Chinese, Japanese, Korean) text
- Automatic deduplication and filtering for extracted images
- Includes batch image resize/compression to reduce vision API costs
- Simple command-line usage with support for pipelines and automation
